newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to absorb 500 bln won from banks.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to absorb 500 bln won from banks.

text.p: The Bank of Korea plans to absorb 500 billion won from banks on Friday through repurchase agreements maturing on December 23, an official at the central bank said.

"The bank has decided to absorb the money as banks have a huge excess liquidity, well over their daily reserve requirement levels," said Chung Myong-chang, chief of the bank's financial market division.
Other officials at the central bank said there were no major tax payments planned for the 10-day period.
